ai_indicator.explanation: Need at least 50 words and 3 sentences; no reliable inference for short clips.

scoring.percentage_formula: 100 * union of query word positions in accepted windows / eligible query words
scoring.coverage_caveat: Coverage of candidate semantic windows; can include unmatched context. Not percentage proven plagiarized. Peer and external percentages are separate, not additive.
scoring.risk_rule: HIGH coverage >=50%; MEDIUM >=15%; else LOW. AI indicator never raises risk alone.
scoring.unknown_rule: Unassessable and fully excluded documents have null scores; partial PDFs cover extracted text only.
